title: Manager x client-type AUM matrix (IPE Top 500, self-reported)
generated_note: Independent of Atlas's own S&P owner/manager data. Each manager self-reports, to IPE Top 500 (2026), how their externally-managed institutional AUM breaks down by client type -- these are the "All Institutional Clients" figures (global, not Europe-only). Converted from EUR to USD at 1.15. Only 140 of the 629 managers in the IPE directory disclosed at least one client-type figure; most disclose some categories and not others, so a blank cell means not disclosed, not zero. "Total" is the sum of the disclosed categories only, so it understates a manager's true total institutional AUM wherever a category is undisclosed -- compare with caution, do not treat blanks as zero when summing down a column for a market-share style total.
